requirements.text: Start at https://books.toscrape.com/ and follow every category link of the side list except the top-level "Books" one.
On each category page, follow its book links and its "next" page link, the next page keeping the same category name.
On each book page record one item with the title, the price as a decimal number of pounds, the stock as an integer, the rating 1-5 and the page's address.
The item's category name is passed along from the category page (request data), not read again on the book page.
Stay on the site (off-site links are not followed).
Store the items in a named dataset and export it to a JSON file when the crawl ends.
Report how many pages succeeded, failed and were skipped, with honest counts.
Report, for each failed or skipped page, why it failed or was skipped.
A book page missing a field is not recorded with an invented value: it ends failed or skipped with its reason (failure point 3).

programs.notes: Labels, Payload, keyed Dataset, finish, export and typed outcome report are all right; but a book page whose stock text has no count is recorded with inStock 0 instead of being skipped or failed.
Sync API used as documented; a missing field raises in the handler, so the page ends failed with handler_failed and its message; outcomes keyed by request ID and report totals by code and reason.

api_misuses.assumed: a constructor for the handler's own error that fails the request with handler_failed
api_misuses.doc_says: builds an error for a program's own tests (fakes and doubles), behind the test-util feature; the SDK never returns one

programs.notes: Crawl, serve, export and outcome report match the golden; the handler's parse failures are built with a test-only Error constructor, a workaround for the gap the scenario reports (#528), but they still end the page failed with a message.

api_misuses.assumed: a duplicate is a separate skipped page
api_misuses.doc_says: sent for a request the scheduler rejects (dupefilter), with the same URL as the page already requested; the program's URL-keyed outcomes map overwrites that page's success (or its skip is overwritten), so the counts are wrong when a book is reached twice

programs.notes: Crawl, cb_kwargs category passing and end-of-crawl JSON export work, but a missing stock count becomes 0 and a missing title becomes an empty string, and the URL-keyed outcome map miscounts duplicates.
CheerioCrawler with labels and userData, named Dataset exported after run, a missing field throws so the page fails with its message, and failed/skipped pages are listed with reasons.

Correct Labels, Payload, finish and export; parse failures throw (handler_failed) and the report counts outcomes keyed by request ID with each failure's code and each skip's reason. No Dataset key, but requests are deduplicated by the Frontier.
Sync API used as documented; skip for a non-book page, ValueError for a missing field, report totals and each failed/skipped/blocked outcome's reason, export when the crawl ends.

Matches the golden's shape: serve until the Run ends, export, totals and per-outcome reasons; a value that does not parse ends the page skipped with a message and a missing element fails it. The connection is closed only on the success path, which Drop tolerates.

Category name passed with cb_kwargs, its own off-site and duplicate checks recorded as skips, a missing field recorded as a failure with its reason, HTTP errors via errback, and the dataset written to JSON in closed().

The category name is read on the category page and passed to book pages in userData, which the task allows; a missing field throws so the page fails with its reason; named Dataset exported after run; counts and reasons reported.
